summary: The INI-AUTO-001 Research-to-Readiness campaign was initialized and opened from the next-campaign recommendation packet before checking the initiative lifecycle-route. The lifecycle-route then correctly returned stop because the selected first slice T-029 was already completed, so the child scope had to be closed without research writes.
lesson: For initiative-bank autonomous-auto campaigns, treat lifecycle-route as a pre-open authority, not a post-open diagnostic. Recommendation packets may suggest a candidate, but route state must be checked before open-next whenever an initiative lifecycle object can be completed, stale, hydrated, or blocked.
impact: Prevents unnecessary child scope opens, write claims, and closeout churn when the route already says stop or requires a fresh candidate/readiness refresh.
recommended_action: Add a pre-open route confirmation step to the autonomous-auto campaign start runbook and consider teaching the next-campaign recommendation packet to include lifecycle-route state for initiative candidates.
